name_ar: الم الله في فاتحة آل عمران وصلا
definition: In the opening of Al Imran, alif lam mim joined to the name of Allah has two readings: the ya of ميم long with a fatha on the meem, or the ya short with a fatha on the meem.
limitations: Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
Only Book A is cited; the printed page is where the section begins and needs proofreading.
The Qaloun count makes Al Imran 1 one ayah that holds both words, so the pair is read inside the ayah; the waqf sign after الم is not treated as a stop.
Both readings are listed in `variants`; the book gives no lengths for them and none is added.

conditions.description: Alif lam mim is followed, in the same ayah, by the name of Allah.
